thread:
incident-bot: PAGED oncall oncall-ml — multi-GPU jobs failing repeatedly on cluster-west-2, severity: P1. Trigger: automated job failure spike and alert from job-monitoring.

oncall-ml (Priya): I’m on it. which nodes/pods? any obvious customer impact?

eng-runtime (Marco): seeing a flurry of tensor/pipeline jobs hitting OOM + NCCL communicator errors. one node shows container crash loops. Pod labels: job=tp-infer, model=customer-c-928, shard=tp4. Sample error from container logs:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "serve.py", line 212, in <module>
    torch.distributed.init_process_group(backend='nccl', ...)
RuntimeError: NCCL ERROR Unhandled system error
E/CUDA: Xid 79 detected, killing process 0x55f3a1c0
```

eng-sre (Jin): node id: n-west-23 shows repeated kernel Xid79 (GPU reset). looks like ephemeral fabric flaps + container oom. marker: nv_peer_mem WARN in dmesg. Recommend cordon + drain node and restart affected containers.

alice (infra): I can cordon now. @oncall-ml do you want me to drain or just cordon and hold for handoff?

oncall-ml (Priya): drain please. include --delete-local-data; we need to move running customer infer jobs off. also collect `kubectl describe pod` and `kubectl logs --previous` for the crashed pod.

bob (mlops): FYI we've seen similar with TP4 when NCCL p2p tries to use NVLINK and the link resets. temporary mitigation: set env `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` and `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` on the pod template to force socket-based rendezvous. may increase latency but keeps jobs alive.

eng-runtime (Marco): running commands now:

```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l job=tp-infer -o wide
kubectl describe pod tp-infer-c-928-4 -n inference
kubectl logs tp-infer-c-928-4 -n inference --previous > /tmp/tp-c928-previous.log
```

eng-sre (Jin): cordoning node n-west-23

```
kubectl cordon n-west-23
kubectl drain n-west-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

alice (infra): drain started. evictions in progress, but 2 of 8 pods Failed to evict due to local storage, forcing delete.

cust-success (Rosa): customer c-928 reporting increased 504s and slow responses since ~09:12 UTC. They’re on a dedicated infer pool; asking for ETA. please post updates I can send them.

oncall-ml (Priya): estimated 15-25m to reschedule pods to healthy nodes, then validate model correctness. can we failover that customer to their backup pool? @eng-runtime

eng-runtime (Marco): we have fallback pool in us-west-1 but cross-region adds latency. alternative: restart pods on same region but single-GPU variant (tp shard->dp single-gpu) to avoid NCCL path. can push a canary image with env overrides to reduce NCCL peer usage.

eng-sre (Jin): immediate action plan:
- cordon+drain node n-west-23 (in progress)
- delete crashed containers and let deployment recreate with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 (temp)
- monitor GPU reset counts on node for 30m
- if resets continue, cordon related nodes and isolate NIC or escalate to infra

bob (mlops): sample patch to deployment (one-liner):

```
kubectl set env deployment/tp-infer N NAMESPACE=inference NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
```

(oncall-ml later) oncall-ml (Priya): applied the env patch as a staged rollout (+ canary 1 pod). canary pod started, logs show no NCCL init failure so far. asking cust-success for any visible change.

cust-success (Rosa): customer c-928 reports partial recovery: 30% fewer 504s, still some latency. they asked if this is a permanent fix.

eng-runtime (Marco): it’s a mitigation. root cause likely NVLINK/P2P path + a GPU driver bug triggered by a race under heavy pipeline parallel rendezvous. we'll need driver & kernel dmesg for node and NVLINK health check. opening a follow-up ticket for driver pinning and long-term fix.

eng-sre (Jin): checking node dmesg, found repeated messages:

```
GPU 0: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus
nv_peer_mem: warning: ib_alloc_cq: failed
```

alice (infra): escalation to infra: possible NIC/IB firmware flapping. i'll create a maintenance ticket to roll nodes with latest firmware once we stabilize. for now leaving node cordoned.

oncall-ml (Priya): customer update: "We saw degradation around 09:12, team applied a mitigation, reduced errors, asking for ETA on permanent fix." Rosa please share our mitigation and ETA 24-48h for driver/infra investigation.

cust-success (Rosa): will send that and request a status page note.

eng-runtime (Marco): marking incident handled for immediate recovery. handing to eng-sre for postmortem and infra for hardware investigation. summary: NCCL communicator init failures + CUDA Xid79 -> container crashes -> customer 504s. temporary mitigation applied: `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1`, canary healthy.

eng-sre (Jin): copying to postmortem channel. creating postmortem ticket INC-4937774242. recommend collecting:
- `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`
- `dmesg` before/after resets
- kubelet logs on n-west-23
- kube events for the evicted pods

oncall-ml (Priya): if anything else pops, re-pager me. otherwise handoff complete.

incident-bot: RESOLVED (mitigated) — incident auto-closed for paging. severity downgraded to P2 for investigation and hardware remediation.

alice (infra): node n-west-23 remains cordoned. scheduling rolling-replace for this rack in next maintenance window.

bob (mlops): follow-up note: we'll prepare a small test harness to reproduce TP4 nvlink stress with toggled NCCL envs and collect kernel logs.

eng-runtime (Marco): thanks all. postmortem draft in #postmortems in 24h.
